newsitem.title: GERMANY: Thyssen to hold news conference on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Thyssen to hold news conference on Thursday.

text.p: German industry group Thyssen AG has called a news conference for 1400 GMT on Thursday to outline the details of the merger of its steel company with that of rival Krupp after a week of grueling negotiations.
Thyssen said on Wednesday its chairman Dieter Vogel would discuss the first results of the talks with his counterpart at Krupp, Gerhard Cromme, after a meeting of Thyssen's supervisory board.

Thyssen and Krupp were expected to reach agreement later on Wednesday and sign a memorandum of understanding to merge their steel companies in a restructuring programme that would be carried out over four years and cost up to 8,000 jobs.
The talks began last week after Krupp launched a hostile takeover bid for its larger rival and then agreed to withdraw the bid if Thyssen entered talks about merging their steel companies.

The two companies have initially agreed that Thyssen would hold at least 60 percent of the new steel company, which will have annual crude steel output of 15 million tonnes and become the Europe's largest maker of flat steel products.
